title: fix(example-crm): full-name contact titles, a complete zh-CN bundle, declared highlight strips and a user-typed lead owner
body:
domain:ui#4 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jR7ZFkpqmm4U8S1f9y

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb23RtUpCQPUEM3SvkuwNQzr)_

Fixes #28870

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：改 `examples/app-crm` 的元数据，另把 `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json` 里 app-crm 的未翻译上限从 101 写成 0。联系人标题改为全名（`nameField: 'full_name'`，公式声明 `returnType: 'text'`）；五个对象的复数名去掉「列表」；zh-CN 词条补齐导航、字段、选项、仪表板、数据集、对象描述、校验提示和欢迎页（`os lint --i18n-strict` 未翻译数 101 → 0）；客户、联系人、商机、线索、活动各声明 `highlightFields`（不含阶段字段，阶段已由阶段路径显示）；线索「分配给」改为用户字段；误挂在 Acme 下的 "Discovery Call — Bletchley Systems" 改名为 "Discovery Call — Acme Platform Renewal"；仪表板说明改写成业务语言。
- **为什么改**：#26676 裁决 B 把 app-crm 定为预览面，它的元数据错误在评审里被当成平台缺陷。维护者裁决：「联系人标题只显示 “Ada”，不处理，这种就是元数据的bug」，所以平台不动，只修元数据。
- **风险与回滚**：风险低。示例包是私有包，不发布；平台代码零改动。种子不再给线索写 `assigned_to`（原值是客户联系人的邮箱，不是用户），新库里该列为空，要在界面上分配。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `examples/app-crm/src/objects/lead.object.ts`（`assigned_to` 改为 `Field.user`，`is_closed` 声明 `boolean`）；② `examples/app-crm/src/data/index.ts`（去掉种子里的邮箱、活动改名）；③ `examples/app-crm/src/objects/contact.object.ts`（标题字段）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh -p 38427`，浏览器语言设为中文后登录：侧栏是「线索 / 客户 / 联系人 / 商机 / 活动 / 销售漏斗」，联系人页标题是 "Ada Lovelace"，页签没有「列表」二字。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Every metadata edit is in `examples/app-crm`, per the ruling: no platform change, no lint, no inference, no gate. The one other file is the app-crm row of the i18n coverage baseline.

1. **Contact title.** `crm_contact` declares `nameField: 'full_name'`, and the `full_name` formula declares `returnType: 'text'`, which makes it title-eligible. Title, lookups and pickers read "Ada Lovelace".
2. **Plural labels.** The zh-CN `pluralLabel` of account, contact, opportunity, lead and activity is the plain noun (客户, 联系人, 商机, 线索, 活动).
3. **zh-CN bundle.** Navigation entries keyed by id (`nav_leads` … `nav_pipeline_dashboard`), every declared field label, every select option (industry, stage, approval status, lead status and source, activity type and status), the line-item object, the `crm_convert_lead` action, the dashboard title, description and six widgets, the `opportunity_metrics` dataset (tile and axis names), object descriptions, the five validation messages and the welcome page.
4. **Highlight fields.** Picks, at most 6, never the title field, and never the field the record page already draws as the stage path (`detectStatusField`: opportunity `stage`, lead and activity `status`), so the stage is not shown twice once #28868 shows a declared strip as declared:
   - `crm_account`: `industry`, `annual_revenue`, `website`
   - `crm_contact`: `account`, `email`
   - `crm_opportunity`: `account`, `amount`, `close_date`, `probability`
   - `crm_lead`: `company`, `source`, `lead_score`, `assigned_to`
   - `crm_activity`: `type`, `due_date`, `contact`, `account`
5. **Lead owner.** `crm_lead.assigned_to` is `Field.user` (target `sys_user`). The seed no longer writes the four email addresses into it; see the deviation below.
6. **Seed ownership.** The activity "Discovery Call — Bletchley Systems" was linked to Acme Corp, Ada and the Acme renewal. It is renamed "Discovery Call — Acme Platform Renewal" to match its links.
7. **Dashboard copy.** The widget and dashboard descriptions are rewritten in business words (no `compareTo`, no chart-type notes) and translated.

Also, as a bounded in-place fix of the same class as item 1 (a formula without its result type), `crm_lead.is_closed` declares `returnType: 'boolean'`. The zh-CN lead page showed the raw word "false" under 已关闭; it now shows 否.

### Deviation from the card (seat ruling B)

The card asks for "seeded user references" on `assigned_to`. Measured on `45efba2a`: no `sys_user` row exists when app-crm's seed runs. The dev admin is minted at `kernel:ready`, after `AppPlugin.start()` seeds, and people otherwise come from sign-up (`examples/app-showcase/src/security/demo-personas.ts`; `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx`, "Owner-style fields"). The only way to resolve a seeded user reference would be for app-crm to seed `sys_user` rows itself. Those are directory rows with no login, and `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` (the `#14157` docblock) records that seeded people close the first-visitor bootstrap sign-up under `invite_only`. The seat ruled option B: `Field.user`, and the seed leaves the field unset, which is the documented owner-style pattern. The acceptance screenshot of the lead list was taken after assigning three leads in the UI.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-crm typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-crm test`: 7 files, 48 tests passed.
- `os lint --i18n-strict` on the app: 0 errors (was 101 untranslated declared strings). The 4 remaining `field-no-consumers` warnings were on the base too; the base had 9, and the highlight strips and the contact title now consume 5 of them.
- `os validate`: exit 0.
- Fresh boot (`pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh`): seed loads 28 rows with no unresolved-reference line.

## Acceptance notes

- Screenshots (1440 px, zh-CN, fresh boot; 375 px contact page too) are held in the maintainer's project folder `issue-28870/` and are not uploaded to GitHub: `zh-account-page.png`, `zh-contact-page.png`, `zh-lead-list.png`, plus the lead, opportunity, activity and dashboard pages and the account and contact lists. The seat read them before landing.
- `crm_contact.full_name` is a text formula, so the title is display-only: a sort by it is refused and search does not reach it. Search still finds a contact by `last_name` and `email` (both `searchable`). The contact list and record page load and render the full name; see the screenshots. A stored text field with an `expression` would make the title searchable; the card ruled the formula, so this PR keeps it.
- zh-CN `assigned_to` reads 分配给, because the platform's `owner_id` already reads 负责人 on the same page.
- `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json`: the app-crm entry is written down from 101 to 0 by `node scripts/check-i18n-coverage.mjs --update` (claim amended to add this one entry), so a regression cannot creep back under the old ceiling. No other entry moved.
- No changeset: `@objectstack/example-crm` is private and publishes nothing, so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.
